title: tectaria hilocarpa
intro: Tectaria hilocarpa, commonly known as the Hilo tree fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for wound healing and infection prevention. The therapeutic actions of Tectaria hilocarpa include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
